title: Quest Board and Daily Quests
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:task
| stats count as quests, sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as completed by quest_type
| eval completion_pct=round(100*completed/quests,1)
| sort - completion_pct
description: Frames your to-dos as daily, weekly, and epic quests and tracks how many you complete.
value: Reframing chores as quests is a small trick that makes ordinary tasks more inviting to finish.
implementation: Ingest tasks tagged as quests into `index=personal`; track completion by quest type.
visualization: Bar chart of quest completion by type.
grandmaExplanation: It turns your to-do list into daily and epic quests, making everyday tasks more fun to finish.
